title.narrative: Export Growth for Export Ready Businesses

description.narrative: This project’s objective is to upgrade the capacity of well-established firms (Export Ready Businesses) to reach and thrive in new export markets. It involves providing firm level support on standards, pricing, competition, marketing, labelling, packaging and distribution in foreign markets, as well as direct hands-on market linkages. It involves hiring of TA and Young Professionals.Key components for the project include;1.Export Development Programme (Firm level support, Export advisor initiative)2.Technical Assistance to RDB’s Export Dept and SEZAR3.Institutional Support through a Young Professionals Programme
